Interpretation

Counts describe content interest, not unique people or confirmed legal needs. “No matching searches” measures demand gaps without retaining the entered text. Country is inferred from time zone and may be unknown or inaccurate. Abuse controls can undercount repeated or shared-network activity.

Use these results to prioritise better answers, links to relevant checklists and training, and future topic additions.
